messages:
Eli (Product): Pushed a new playground streaming mock 1: small inline token meter, 'Hold' control to let user freeze streaming without discarding partial output, and prompt-library inline preview that shows token delta before insert. Figma: https://redwood-internal.mock/s/stream-v3. Quick feedback requested before we lock the copy. Maya (Design): General thumbs up. A couple of UX worries: 'Hold' reads odd to some folks; 'Pause' is more familiar. Also want the token meter to show 1) live tokens, 2) model limit, 3) small cost hint on hover. On collapsed messages the meter should shrink to a dot to avoid clutter. Sam (Eng): FYI on implementation: full server-side resume mid-stream isn't feasible with current infer stack (no resumable decoder state). We can implement a client-driven "pause" by aborting the stream, storing the partial text client side, and re-requesting with that text as a prefix. Needs dedup logic and safety checks for prompt-inserted completions. Suggest we add a `resume_session` boolean in telemetry so we can track UX quality. Rin (A11y): Accessibility from SR perspective: continuous streaming triggers screen readers to recite every small token. Don't use `aria-live="assertive"` on the whole message body. Instead batch updates and expose an update summary region: ```html
Streaming: 4 chunks received
```Ensure the Pause/Stop control is reachable with a single Tab from the composer and has an aria-label like `Pause generation (shortcut Esc)`. Token meter contrast currently fails: must be at least 4.5:1 or treated as large text at 3:1. Theo (DevEx): Token copy proposal: tooltip text = "Tokens: X used • model cap Y • est cost $Z". For prompt-library inserts show a modal: "This snippet will add +N tokens (est $M). Insert?" Keyboard flows: Enter to accept, Esc to dismiss. Also: log `token_delta` on insert events. Maya (Design): Uploaded variant C with 'Pause' label and a secondary "Stop & keep" option for users who want to halt and keep what's there. Moved token meter to left gutter when message width < 600px. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.mock/s/stream-v3b :sparkles: Eli (Product): Sounds good. Quick decisions: use 'Pause' as primary label, keep 'Stop & keep' as secondary; token tooltip per Theo; accessible batching per Rin. Sam (Eng): Plan for spike: 1) client-side pause POC; 2) add dedup heuristics (simple overlap detection + small token-hash); 3) telemetry keys: `resumed_session` (bool), `partial_bytes` (int), `token_delta` (int). Will aim for rough POC in 5 working days. Rin (A11y): I'll draft a small QA checklist: focus order, aria-live batching interval (recommend 300ms), SR verbosity test cases, contrast samples. Theo (DevEx): I'll wire the token tooltip copy and add the prompt-insert modal prototype to the prompt library branch. Also adding `token_delta` to analytics schema. Eli (Product): Action items: Maya -> finalize visuals + contrast; Sam -> spike pause/resume POC + telemetry; Rin -> QA checklist; Theo -> token tooltip + prompt-insert modal. Scheduling 30m review next Tue. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
